title: Items file (in-game item ID -> name and stats)

id.description: u16 item ID as stored in the save's item box / pouch

aliases.description: Other English spellings of the same item (EU, MHP2G fan patch, FUComplete, datamine enum, and spellings used in this repo's recipe data)

rarity.description: From the disc's item table (mhfu-extract build-data). Omitted on placeholders

carry.description: Carry limit, from the disc's item table. 255 on Normal S Lv1, which is unlimited. Omitted on placeholders

price.description: Price in zenny, from the disc's item table: the shops' buy price for items they sell. Omitted on placeholders

regions.description: Releases that carry a real name for this ID. Omitted when present in all of jp, us, eu.

placeholder.description: Not a real item (UI placeholder / developer padding)
